description: PinyinPal decision log — the machine catalog of every tracked decision across the repo (ADR records, tech-mapping D-tracker, planning OI record, business BM register). One record per decision: { id, title, status, file, date }. Sibling of component-registry.json and page-inventory.json. Validated by check:system-map; the human ADR/decision index is generated from this JSON (never a second hand-maintained list). Status vocab: proposed | ratified | superseded.
scope: Decisions that are anchored in a committed doc (status: ratified) or tracked as pending (status: proposed). D-items whose committed home is the ratified epic plan (docs/planning/epics-25-40.md); OI items are the plan's decision record; ADR records live in design-reasoning.md / guides/adr; BM-1 is the ratified business model. D1-D9 decision records are anchored in the committed epic plan (docs/planning/epics-25-40.md) and this log.
